filter_game_messages_for_power: filter a pydipcc Game messages to only those sent or received by a specific power using game_from_view_of
filter_game_messages_for_two_powers: filter a pydipcc Game messages to only those exchanged between two specific powers using game_from_two_party_view
assert_game_view_integrity: assert a pydipcc Game contains no messages outside a specific power's view using assert_game_from_view_of
get_draw_vote_state: get the current draw vote state for all powers in a pydipcc Game using get_game_draw_state
check_cross_power_support_or_convoy: check if an order is a friendly cross-power support or convoy using is_friendly_xpower_support_or_convoy
